subject: Renewal engagement: runway plan & QBR windowing
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@lumery.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal engagement: runway plan & QBR windowing

Alex —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. As Lumery’s renewal window opens next quarter, I wanted to surface a concise engagement plan so we can lock the timeline, stakeholders, and the QBR slot. High level here and 3 clear asks at the bottom.

Summary (proposed):
- Term: 12-month renewal with optional 12-month staircase uplift (we can draft alternatives).
- Capacity: +30% baseline token capacity to accommodate new inference pipelines you mentioned (routing + batch caching).
- Commercial ask: we’ll scope a one-time onboarding credit vs. larger term discount depending on which capacity bundle you select.

Proposed timeline:
- May 22–26: stakeholder alignment and sign-off on capacity profile
- Jun 5–9: QBR to review performance, runbook, and final pricing
- Jun 12: contract sent for legal review
- Jun 26: target renewal effective date

QBR window suggestions (pick one):
- Tue Jun 6 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed Jun 7 14:00–15:00 PT
- Thu Jun 8 08:30–09:30 PT

Attachments: Renewal_Playbook_v1.pdf (high-level proposal; redlines and options on page 3). I’ve also included a small calendar payload (QBR_Calendar_Options.ics) with the three proposed slots.

Action items / asks — please (1) confirm which QBR slot works for you, (2) confirm stakeholders who should attend (legal, procurement, SRE), and (3) whether Lumery is leaning toward a term change or a capacity-only renewal.

I’ll follow up with an internal playbook (Marissa will run the QBR) and a short one-pager on the capacity uplift scenarios.

Thanks — look forward to locking dates.

— Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachment stubs: Renewal_Playbook_v1.pdf (12 pages; summary & pricing matrix), QBR_Calendar_Options.ics (3 events)

Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@lumery.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 11:05:32 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal engagement: runway plan & QBR windowing

Karthik —

Thanks for the clear plan. Wed Jun 7 14:00–15:00 PT works best for our team (Priya will attend). We also want to loop procurement — I’ll add our procurement lead once we confirm the slot. Two quick notes:

1) We’re evaluating a 24-month term to smooth unit pricing across FY29; can you prepare a comparison (12 vs 24 months) with net effective CPI and a model for staged capacity increases?
2) For the +30% capacity ask, can you confirm whether this is burst capacity or baseline? We’re interested in baseline increase if possible, but need the impacts on latency SLOs.

I uploaded a quick PO draft to our shared workspace and will send it after internal alignment.

If you want to lock the slot now, go ahead and send invites — otherwise we’ll wait for procurement name.

Best,
Alex
Director, Platform Engineering | Lumery
alex.mercer@lumery.com | +1 617-555-0987

- Stephanie: quick check on commercial levers — is a staircase approach with a small onboarding credit + term discount an option for Lumery? If yes, please share suggested % bands so I can preview with the client.
